# ERSIYAN

> ERSIYAN is the official website of a Korean solo indie game studio that released MINE LOGIC and is developing VELSIEN SUMMIT.

## Official pages

- [ERSIYAN home](https://ersiyan.com/): Studio overview, verified 2026 company history, and official game links.
- [MINE LOGIC](https://ersiyan.com/mine-logic): Android Minesweeper logic puzzle with staged hints, 20 training levels, and offline play.
- [VELSIEN SUMMIT](https://ersiyan.com/velsien-summit): In-development mobile collectible 2D SRPG.
- [Privacy policy](https://ersiyan.com/privacy): Website privacy information.
- [MINE LOGIC privacy policy](https://ersiyan.com/privacy/mine-logic): App-specific privacy information.

## Contact

- Email: help@ersiyan.com
